description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDownstreamSender, which provides functionality for sending messages to a messaging system (Hono) via the Vertx-Proton library. The class includes methods for constructing messages with payloads and properties, handling content-type charset extraction, and sending messages asynchronously.

classes.name: AbstractDownstreamSender
classes.description: An abstract class providing the core implementation for sending messages downstream in a Hono client, utilizing Vertx-Proton messaging.

methods.name: AbstractDownstreamSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sender with connection, sender link, tenant ID, and target address.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Overloaded methods for sending messages with different payload formats (String or byte array), device ID, optional properties, and content type.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds device ID as a property to the message.

methods.name: getCharsetForContentType
methods.description: Extracts charset from content type header, defaults to UTF-8 if none specified.
